Question 14
?

Consider the finite region bounded by y=2x+2 and x=y−2, as shown above. Which of the following gives the volume of the solid generated when that region is rotated 2π radians about the y-axis?

a
π∫24(y−2−[12y−1]2)dy
b
π∫26(y−2−[12y−1]2)dy
c
π∫26([12y−1]2−y+2)dy
d
π∫24([12y−1]2−y+2)dy
e
π∫26(y−2−12y+1)dy
Submit
